name: Australodocus
isnote: Named in 2007 as a diplodocid; later analyses (Whitlock 2011) and PBDB differ, PBDB placing it in Somphospondyli.
sum: Australodocus is a Late Jurassic sauropod from the Tendaguru beds of Lindi, Tanzania, known from two vertebrae.
wsnote: Known from two vertebrae; no size figure was read.
holotype: Vertebrae from a series of four collected in 1909 by Janensch's expedition; the other bones were destroyed in World War II.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Remes 2007

sources.text: Remes, Kristian 2007. A second Gondwanan diplodocid dinosaur from the Upper Jurassic Tendaguru Beds of Tanzania, East Africa. Palaeontology 50(3): 653–667. doi:10.1111/j.1475-4983.2007.00652.x
